About

This site is the output of the ZeroPress Build Example. It uses the Minimal theme, four sample posts, and this About page.

From inputs to a website

The theme supplies the templates and styles. A Preview Data JSON file contains the content and site settings. The ZeroPress builder combines them into static HTML and assets in the dist/ directory.

Explore the result

Browse the posts, move between the two pages of the post list, or search for a title such as Typography. The layout and colors adapt to your screen and system preference.

For an overview of the builder and ways to publish your own site, visit the ZeroPress documentation.
